REGULATION (EU) 2016/9999 OF THE TEST COUNCIL

on bicycle maintenance

Whereas:

(1)

Bicycles need regular care.

(2)

Chains rust when left wet.

HAS ADOPTED THIS REGULATION:

CHAPTER I

General provisions

Article premier

Subject matter

This Regulation sets rules for keeping bicycles in working order.

Article 2

Definitions

For the purposes of this Regulation:

(1)

'chain' means the part that drives the rear wheel;

(2)

'brake' means the part that stops the bicycle.

CHAPTER II

Maintenance

Article 3

Chain care

1.   The chain shall be oiled every month.

2.   The chain shall be cleaned:

(a)

after rain;

(b)

before oiling.

3.   The tools listed in the Annex shall be used.

This Regulation shall be binding in its entirety.

Done at Testville, 1 January 2016.

ANNEX

Tools

A chain tool, a brush and oil.

(1)  A footnote that must not end up in any unit.
